items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I thought he was probably the tastiest drummer I’ve ever known... there was nobody like Shelly

ctx.x: No, I don’t think, but I thought he was probably the tastiest drummer I’ve ever known and one who had the best sense of sound. You'd never have to write a part for Shelly, he would listen and always knew exactly what to play and what a guy to have man, there was nobody like Shelly, he was funny, he was just one the most marvelous men I’ve ever known.
